rationale: No evidence-supported optimization fits this workflow without weakening required build/test coverage or relying on unsupported assumptions. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9) requires a measurable repeated dependency-fetch step with cacheable inputs such as a lockfile/environment; this workflow uses prebuilt container images and runs autotools configure/make/make check with no package-manager install or lockfile step, so there is no dependency download to cache. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242) is contraindicated because every matrix combination across SDK, compiler, tracing, build-type, and cudart variants is needed to validate the PR; cancelling remaining matrix cells on a failure would hide required results and reduce coverage, and the evidence itself flags branch-protection/required-check safety as needing separate review. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) needs representative successful-duration history to set a safe per-job budget; only run-level timestamps are available, and an arbitrary timeout risks breaking valid slow container builds. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is already present via concurrency.cancel-in-progress: true. Change filtering, workflow skipping, and output removal would reduce required coverage and are not supported here.
